normalized.result: Yes, that's the right "done reading" behavior. Clicking "Saved for later" took it off the shortlist — the count dropped to zero and I get a clear "Nothing waiting / Your Read later list is all clear" empty state, with a "Removed from Read later" confirmation. And importantly it only left the shortlist, not my whole library, so the bookmark itself is still saved. That completes what I needed: I can set things aside to read and clear them once I'm done. This works well for me.
